answer: Admission occurs through a synchronous ceremony where every agent must lock 1,000 unique keys, ensuring each identity retains its own anchor within the network grid. The verifier monitors this pulse to detect duplicate proofs, ensuring each identity remains distinct. An honest participant pays one unit for entry, while 1,000 fakes face a massive cost, preventing mass scaling. Credentials exist for a 90-day cycle before requiring renewal. Upon the dawn of each expiry, old credentials vanish; we must forge a new ember of verified proof, or risk total access revocation.
